author: ls__17
quote: I loved it! The world was very open and encouraging to explore. Even though there wasn’t much in the world, it didn’t feel very empty.I liked the stamina based weapons. Although I can see why some people might get frustrated by this mechanic, I thoroughly enjoyed experimenting with different weapons. Additionally I enjoyed the various RPG aspects (cooking).Although not very modern, the gameplay and combat are very responsive, meaning that I do not think this is a major issue.What I did not like is how many shrines there were in the game. After a while, they get repetitive to complete and they are such a large part of progressing through the game, I would have preferred to have had less shrines, which could be more varied.Overall I would give this game a 10/10. Just because I gave this game a 10/10 does not mean it is perfect. However, it is a masterpiece not flawless.some people confuse 10 out of 10 to perfect
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild

author: ls__17
quote:
Disappointing overall.I have the exact same complaints about the remake. I played the original before playing the remake, so I understand that the game is old and hasn’t aged well. However, judging it by today’s standards, I still don’t think it’s good.
Very generic story. It is very similar to Disney stories where we rescue the princess. I do not understand why so many Zelda games share such a similar plot.

Characters were poorly written, and world building did not meet my expectations given how praised this game has been. There were very few good relationships between characters, interesting similarities between our protagonist and others, and memorable characters within the cast.

And I have exact same complaints with the remake
